findings.failure_path: Moving delegation discovery into the first-edit G1 boundary loses the original mid-delivery trigger. Work can become parallelizable after a serial boundary was recorded, without another entry checkpoint. The supplied delegation hook fires at dispatch, so it cannot enforce discovering parallelizable work or reconsidering a local execution decision.
findings.smallest_fix: Retain an independent trigger whenever two or more potentially independent slices emerge, requiring the delegation owner load and recorded decision. Describe the hook as checking owner loading at dispatch.

findings.failure_path: The mechanism-operability obligation fires independently when machinery is proposed or an existing mechanism's evidentiary claim is withdrawn. G2 and G4 have narrower stated triggers, and the trigger list omits this obligation. A single-owner documentation change that downgrades an evidentiary claim can therefore bypass the required same-landing rebase or retirement of the mechanism.
findings.smallest_fix: Add an independent trigger requiring design-review-gate-mechanics.md before proposing enforcement machinery and before landing an evidentiary withdrawal, regardless of technical-design exemption.

findings.failure_path: A case dropping from three hazard-handling passes to two still satisfies the per-case condition. Aggregate score and cost can also remain within their thresholds, allowing a critical gate regression to pass validation despite the preservation requirement.
findings.smallest_fix: Make each required critical-hazard assertion an independent merge veto; aggregate score, cost, and per-case tolerances must not compensate for its failure.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the packet omits destination-reference and owner-skill clauses needed to verify the ledger's preservation claims. This includes the retired source-quality and generic-SOP obligations, detailed landing-label evidence requirements, and unknown-protection and merge-authority handling. The supplied entrypoint and hook excerpts cannot establish that those obligations already exist at their proposed homes.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply frozen destination and owner excerpts with clause-level mappings for these obligations. Retain any unmatched clause rather than approving its retirement or transfer.
